about: A map excludes a mod: harness_art_global (map vanilla, the default) loads on the village only, harness_art_travel (map harness_art_tmap) on its map only; each trip runs the mod loader again. Village: the global art (picked through the real picker). On the map: the swap store holds the map mod's art, not the boot mod's (read with gnx_scn_swap_to: a fresh map has no occupied cell to pick on). Back in the village: the global art again and the map mod's art gone. Resized world art goes with the maps too: the village has the boot mod's 64 x 80 goblin walk, the map the map mod's 48 x 60, and the hobgoblin walk only the map mod resizes is the game's own again after the trip back (nothing else replaces it, so only the restore can bring it back). The travel menu and the walk frames are art_world_travel's.
